non_goals: No coverage of all HoTT terms, arbitrary partial programs, consumers, unbounded syntax or future grammar extensions is claimed.
No HoTT-specific cause, univalence/HIT necessity, universal halting undecidability or global paradox-discovery completeness is claimed.
The preserved task fields are formal correspondence data, not an empirical proof of physical-reality correspondence.
The retained UnsupportedIndexedMatch diagnostic limits computational reduction on transported indexed Raw values; no theorem consumer in this package uses that case.

scope: Machine-check exhaustive enumeration of the exact bounded Raw n completion grammar, normalization into the canonical Delay Bool model, preservation of convergence and deadline observation, preservation of the frozen task horizon and expected observation, and coverage of every reduced candidate in the generated canonical space.
